svg.title: Petri dish
svg.desc: Top-view petri dish with lid rim, agar surface, colonies of different sizes, and a streak path. Biological basis: Microbial colonies expand clonally on a nutrient-gel surface and differ in size, opacity, margin, and pigmentation.
